verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official CLI (an npm-installed command-line tool), a hosted MCP server, and an HTTP API with an OpenAPI contract, but no official language SDK or client library that developers can import and build against. The CLI and MCP server are different product surfaces, and the OpenAPI contract is a developer building block, which probes show 404s at its documented location. Neither earns credit for an official-SDK story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
